question: Which of the following Indian classical singers was known as Mallika-e-Ghazal or the Queen of Ghazal and got appreciations by the Nightingale of India, Sarojini Naidu at the age of fifteen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Begum Akhtar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The legendary Begum Akhtar was a doyen of ****Hindustani classical music****, particularly in the ghazal genre.**
 
• Her musical tradition was so unique that she came to be associated with her own distinct style of singing.
 
• She was rightly called the **'Mallika-e-Ghazal'.**
 
• **Akhtari Bai Faizabadi**, also known as Begum Akhtar, was an Indian singer and actress.
 
• She is regarded as one of the greatest singers of **ghazal, Dadra, and thumri genres of Hindustani classical music.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chitra Singh** is an Indian ghazal singer.​ 
 
• She, alongside her husband,** Jagjit Singh, popularized the ghazal genre**. Respectfully known as the **"king and queen of the Ghazal world.**
 
• **Suraiya Jamal Sheikh**, popularly known by the **mononym Suraiya,** was a popular actress and playback singer in India's Hindi-language films.
 
• **Amrutha Suresh** is an Indian singer, composer, songwriter, and radio jockey.
